propertyDetails.description: Stylishly remodeled Victorian-style home offers all the charms of downtown Los Gatos living just steps away from top restaurants and shopping. Inviting two front living spaces feature hardwood floors, crown molding and detailed door casings, large single hung windows, built-in speakers, and Lutron light controls throughout. The updated kitchen is perfect space for a break from downtown eating, featuring quartz counters and tile backsplash, skylight, island, and a large walk-in pantry. 2 large bedrooms on the main level share a full bath. Lower level bedroom suite showcases a luxuriously remodeled Carrara marble tile bathroom, walk-in closet and access to huge basement storage. Tranquil backyard features a paver patio and professional landscaping, while the multi-use detached garage can be easily arranged as an office or studio with large glass sliding doors and covered overhang. Enjoy downtown living in this stylish historic house filled with charming details and modern touches.
